---
name: New skill proposal
about: Propose a new Upwork skill before writing it
title: "[new skill] "
labels: new-skill
---

**What would the skill do?**
One or two sentences. What does the freelancer paste in, what do they get back?

**When would someone reach for it?**
The moment in the Upwork workflow it serves.

**What would it be built from?**
Upwork's published guidance, your own field experience, or both. No invented stats, sources get cited.

**Are you offering to write it?**
Yes / no is fine either way. Proposals without an author still help the roadmap.
